purpose: Phase 1 delivery contract; an evidence-preserving terrain asset inventory.
sourceDataset: ETOPO 2022 bedrock at 60 arc-seconds; original grid is excluded by .gitignore and builders name their derivation.

medium.note: No medium corridor fields exist yet. Phase 2 must derive them from the original elevation grid; they must not be downscaled screenshots.

selectedFormat.fallback: Retained PNG with identical Terrain-RGB bytes.
selectedFormat.loaderStatus: Not selected by the current loader; Phase 3 must use WebP only after feature detection and request the PNG fallback if unavailable.

fields.sceneWindow: Global fallback for the Beat 05–07 slice and Beat 12 unroll.
fields.source: ETOPO 2022 bedrock, area-resampled from data/bathymetry.png by slice/build_slice.py.
fields.precision: Terrain-RGB: elevation_m = (R*256 + G)*0.30518043793392846 - 11000; max quantisation error 0.3061 m.
